name: Cryptoniq Lite – Cryptocurrency Payment Gateway
author: DIVENGINE

sections.description:
Cryptoniq | Cryptocurrency Payment Plugin for WordPress (Decentralized)

Pay with BTC, ETH, TRX, DOGE — easily and securely.

Cryptoniq is a WooCommerce payment plugin that enables your store to accept cryptocurrency payments with direct-to-wallet transactions.

💰 Coins (Lite Version)

  • Bitcoin (BTC)
  • Ethereum (ETH)

🔒 To unlock support for more coins, upgrade to the Pro Version:
– Litecoin (LTC)
– Dogecoin (DOGE)
– TRON (TRX)
– Solana (SOL)
– Arbitrum One (ARB)
– Optimism (OP)
– USDT & USDC support on multiple chains

🔗 Decentralized Payment System

Most crypto gateways require signups, hosted wallets, and withdrawal fees.

Cryptoniq is different:
– No 3rd-party registration
– No withdrawal fees
– Direct payment to your crypto wallet

🛠 Powerful Admin Panel

Manage wallets, coin selection, price settings, and more from an intuitive interface.

💸 Payment Box

Beautiful, responsive, and user-friendly payment UI.

💱 Currency Support

Supports 169+ fiat currencies (USD, EUR, etc.) for price conversions.

🌐 Official Website

Visit https://cryptoniq.io/wp/ for documentation and updates.

📖 Documentation

Read the full documentation: https://divengine.ticksy.com/articles/100013199/

Translations

  • English (default)
  • Spanish
  • German (Deutsch)
  • Italian
  • Russian
  • Hindi
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open “Cryptoniq” admin options panel.
sections.faq:
What makes Cryptoniq unique?

Cryptoniq is fully decentralized — payments go directly from buyer to seller, without middlemen.
